name_note: GTDB g__Enterenecus corresponds to Candidatus Enterenecus and also contains genomes labelled Pseudoflavonifractor and Alistipes in NCBI.

sentences.text: Enterenecus is a bacterial genus reported at the genus level in 16S rRNA sequencing analysis of the cecal microbiota of Muscovy ducks.
A study of Muscovy ducks reported lower relative abundance of Enterenecus in males than in females, alongside differences in overall cecal microbiota composition between the sexes.
In Linwu ducks, a study reported that fermented ramie feed reduced the relative abundances of Enterenecus and Desulfovibrio in the cecum.
